en.text:
Increases <solar/>Solar Weapon and <solar/>Ignition damage while <solar/>Roaring Flames currently active.

Benefits at <solar/>Roaring Flames x1|x2|x3:
• 6%|9.2%|12.4% increased Weapon Damage
• 15%|20%|24.9% increased Ignition Damage

The number <stasis/>Slow stacks and their duration, as well as the duration of <strand/>Suspend applied to you are halved. Damage from <stasis/>Stasis Breakout is removed.

<stasis/>Stasis or <strand/>Suspend Breakout creates a burst of <solar/>Solar Energy, dealing up to 105 damage in a 9 meter radius.
